name: fixhistory
description: FixHistory - Digital Maintenance Passport (MERN full-stack application)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && npm run start:prod --prefix server
